GrocyAPIKeyCredential.title: Grocy API Key
GrocyAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing API key and one public HTTPS instance origin. GROCY-API-KEY header only, fixed /api. Protected location catalog access shows reachability, not identity, key kind, role or ownership. No login, token issue/refresh, Basic/Bearer/OAuth or host fallback. Installed source/spec parity and permissions remain unverified.
